name: Grand Hyatt Denver
positioning: Downtown Denver hotel with a rooftop jogging track and tennis/pickleball court, a heated indoor pool, and rooms with city or Rocky Mountain views
best_for: Travelers wanting a downtown Denver base near 16th Street, Union Station, Coors Field and Ball Arena
Active guests who want a rooftop track and tennis/pickleball court
Families and guests traveling with dogs

facts.text: Grand Hyatt Denver is in downtown Denver, within easy reach of 16th Street, Union Station, Coors Field and Ball Arena.
Guestrooms offer city or Rocky Mountain views.
The hotel has a heated indoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center.
Complimentary tennis rackets and pickleball paddles are available at the front desk.
Families can rent board games and use the rooftop tennis and pickleball court.
The Executive Suite has Rocky Mountain and city views, a king bedroom, a sleeper sofa and a dining table.
The Presidential Suite has Denver skyline views, dining for four and a bath with a soaking tub and walk-in shower.
courier. kitchen & bar is a newsroom-inspired restaurant that nods to the building's history as the former home of one of Denver's oldest newspapers.
Fireside | The Bar in the lobby has linear stacked fireplaces and live music from local artists on select nights.
Grand Hyatt Denver is a dog-friendly hotel that greets dogs with treats.

highlights.text: The hotel has a rooftop jogging track and a combined tennis and pickleball court.
The Pinnacle Club, an event venue 38 floors above the city, has panoramic downtown and Rocky Mountain views.
The High Floor King room on the upper floors offers panoramic downtown Denver and Rocky Mountain views and furnishings by RH.
The redesigned lobby has a fireplace and furnishings by RH.
Honey from the hotel's rooftop beehives is used in cocktails and dishes at Courier and Fireside.

considerations.text: Denver International Airport is 25 miles from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may not suit guests seeking a mountain resort experience.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the hotel's luxury positioning.
